environment.description: EKS cluster running the gRPC comment service pod. PostgreSQL RDS instance with user 'grpc_svc_user' granted full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the 'comments' table. The frontend BFF renders comment bodies using innerHTML without sanitization. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured on the frontend ingress.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON comments TO grpc_svc_user
